7 DAYS. YOUR KIND OF DISCOVERY.

Every day,
a new perspective.

A day-by-day starting point, with room for the moments you never planned.

01DAY 01Arrive on the south coast+

Transfer from the airport toward Galle or Unawatuna and check in. Keep the remainder of the day free for rest and a first seaside dinner. A late flight may require an airport-area first night.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Arrivalbeach atmosphererelaxed dining
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTGalle / Unawatuna
02DAY 02Explore Galle Fort+

Take a leisurely walk through Galle Fort's streets, ramparts and galleries. Enjoy the lighthouse area and sea views, leaving time for cafes or boutiques.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Galle Fortrampartssmall galleries
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTGalle / Unawatuna
03DAY 03A true beach day+

Enjoy a largely unscheduled day by the ocean. Choose a calm shoreline, a scenic cafe or a short coastal excursion according to water conditions and personal preference.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
UnawatunaDalawella arearest
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTUnawatuna
04DAY 04Weligama and the surf coast+

Travel east along the coast to Weligama. Beginners may arrange a lesson with a qualified surf instructor when conditions are suitable; non-surfers can simply enjoy the bay.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Weligama Baycoastal villagessurf option
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTWeligama
05DAY 05The Mirissa mood+

Continue to Mirissa for a quiet day by the shoreline. A responsible, licensed whale-watching trip is a seasonal optional activity, not a guaranteed inclusion.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Mirissa beachcoastal cafesseasonal sea option
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTMirissa
06DAY 06Tangalle and slower shores+

Travel to the Tangalle area and choose a quieter beach setting. Spend the afternoon relaxing, reading, enjoying local seafood or taking an appropriate guided nature excursion.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Tangalletranquil beachesdowntime
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTTangalle
07DAY 07Coast to airport+

Return toward Colombo and the airport with ample time for traffic and check-in. For early departures, the final night should be shifted closer to the airport.

THE LITTLE HIGHLIGHTS
Coastal returnonward journey
☾
SUGGESTED NIGHTDeparture

Suggested pacing and overnight areas. Day order and stops can change with arrival times, weather, access and your preferred pace.

THE LITTLE DETAILS MATTER

Thoughtfully planned.
Ready to make yours.

This is a flexible trip concept, rather than a confirmed departure or booking. We’ll shape the practical details around your dates and preferences.

Dates & weather+

Match the regions and experiences with your travel dates. Beach, surf and wildlife conditions vary across the island.

Access & activities+

Attraction access, park blocks, guides, vehicle availability, rail seats and optional activities are confirmed during planning.

Your pace+

Climbs, early starts, walking demands and road transfers can be adjusted around your mobility, interests and comfort.

Price & inclusions+

No fixed package price, hotel category, meals, guide services or admission tickets are included or confirmed by this outline.

Thoughtful travel+

Respect sacred places, communities and wildlife. Animal sightings and sea-based activities are never guaranteed.
